Short title and commencement

BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
ACT IV OF 1974
An Act to provide for the establishment of Baluchistan Public Service
Commission
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 27th June 1974]
No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the Baluchistan Public Service
Commission Act, 1974.
(2) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on 14th January 1974.

Definitions

BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
ACT IV OF 1974
An Act to provide for the establishment of Baluchistan Public Service
Commission
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 27th June 1974]
No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
2. Definitions.------In
this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) "Commission" means the Baluchistan Public
Service Commission established under this Act;
(b) "Government" means
the Government of Baluchistan;
(c) "member" means a
member of the Commission and, unless the context otherwise requires, includes
the Chairman thereof;
(d) "prescribed" means
prescribed by rules made under this Act; and
(e) "service of
Pakistan" means the service of Pakistan as defined in the Constitution of
Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

Composition of Commission

BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
ACT IV OF 1974
An Act to provide for the establishment of Baluchistan Public Service
Commission
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 27th June 1974]
No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
3. Composition of
Commission.---(1) There shall be a Baluchistan Public Service Commission
consisting of two members to be appointed by the Government:
Provided that the Government may
increase the number of members for such period as it may determine and may
appoint one or more persons in the service of Pakistan to be members ex officio
for the discharge of such functions as it may determine.
(2) the Government shall nominate
one of the members to be the Chair man of the Commission.
(3) No proceeding or act of the
Commission shall be invalid merely on the ground of existence of any vacancy
in, or any defect in the constitution of the Commission.

Terms of office of members

BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
ACT IV OF 1974
An Act to provide for the establishment of Baluchistan Public Service
Commission
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 27th June 1974]
No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
4. Terms of office of
members,--(1) A member shall hold office for a term of three years from the
date on which be enters upon his office:
Provided that the Government may-
(a) extend the term of office of
a member for such period as it may
determine; and
(b) for reasons to be recorded in
writing, terminate the appointment of a member before the expiration of his
term of office.
(2) A member may resign his
office by writing under his hand addressed to the Government.
(3) The pay and other terms and
conditions of service of members shall be such as may be determined by the
Government.

Functions of the Commission

BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
BALUCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974
ACT IV OF 1974
An Act to provide for the establishment of Baluchistan Public Service
Commission
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 27th June 1974]
No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
5. Functions of the
Commission.----The functions of the Commission shall be-
(a) to conduct tests and
examinations for recruitment to-
(i) the Provincial Civil Services
and such civil posts in connection with the affairs of the Province; and
(ii) such posts in or under a
corporation or other body or organization -set up by the Provincial Government
under any law, as may be prescribed;
(b) to advise the Government on
such matters as may be prescribed, relating to :the terms and conditions of
service of persons-who. are members of Provincial Civil Service or hold civil
posts to connection with the affairs of the Province; and
(c) such other functions as may
be prescribed from time to time.

Power to make Rules

Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
6. Power to make Rules.---The
Governor may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules for carrying
out the purposes Of this Acts.

Validation of actions taken under Baluchistan Ordinance I of 1974

SERVICE COMMISSION ACT, 1974

No. Legis-X-(4)/74.-----The
Baluchistan Public Service Commission Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 7th June 1974, and assented to by the
Governor of Baluchistan is hereby publish ed as an act of the Provincial
Assembly.
7. Validation of actions taken
under Baluchistan Ordinance I of 1974.----The lapse of the Baluchistan
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1974 (Baluchistan Ordinance I of 1974),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordi nance, shall not-
(a) affect the previous operation
of the said Ordinance; or
(b) affect any right, privilege,
obligation or liability acquired, accrued or incurred under the said Ordinance;
or
(c) affect any legal proceeding
or remedy in respect of any such right, privilege, obligation, liability,
penalty, forfeiture as aforesaid; and any such legal proceeding or remedy may
be instituted, continued or enforced, and any such penalty or forfeiture be
considered to have been imposed as if the said Ordinance has not lapsed.
